messages:
alyssa (PM): quick sync on auto-fallback UX — goal: safe defaults, clear reason, easy undo.
max (Eng): runtime can flip routes; we should emit a structured event with route, from, to, trigger, window_sec, metrics.
jorge (SRE): prefer multi-signal triggers (5xx spike OR p95 latency OR validation fail) with hysteresis and cooldown to avoid noise.
maya (Design): show one-line verdict in console and let users expand for sparkline + 3 redacted sample failures. keep it simple.
sam (Infra): API escape hatch: POST /rollouts/{id}/override with reason + dry_run. must append audit entry.
alyssa (PM): pager rules: only page if fallback persists >15m for enterprise or error budget breach; otherwise slack + console banner.
max (Eng): control plane creates a read-only audit-rollout and a suggested patch operators can accept. safer than auto-commits.
jorge (SRE): add derived metric fallback_rate_by_route and 45d trace retention for forensic needs. rate-limit autofallbacks to 1 per route / 10m.
maya (Design): timeline UI: trigger -> switch -> samples -> operator action. include "Unwind" and "Open replay" quick actions.
max (Eng): include model_checksum and kernel_variant in audit for repro; optionally attach prompt-hash snapshot when canary prompts used.
sam (Infra): implement override endpoint and a dry_run flag in API prototype.
alyssa (PM): action items: max spec event v2 + rate-limit, jorge runbook + pager rules, maya mockups, sam API stub. I'll update RFC.
max (Eng): noted. will post schema doc.
jorge (SRE): posting runbook draft to #eng-oncall later today.
maya (Design): mockups by EOD Wed.
sam (Infra): PR for override endpoint next week.
alyssa (PM): thanks everyone. call out any missing edge-cases here.
max (Eng): edge: validation failures might correlate with prompt drift — hook eval pipeline.
jorge (SRE): also require a 2m stable window before switching back to avoid oscillations.
audit-bot: logged 'autofallback_sync_ack' for 1694000000
